rule: Fire runs on its own heat: fire reflux is a damage multiplier, and fire skills build it, scale with it, or spend it.

skills.name: Kiln Fist
skills.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Alight, interrupts. If it was already burning, every stack is spent for +40 and the blow bursts, lighting those beside it.
skills.verb_fit: Burn is "set a target burning": two Alight in one blow, and it cashes in a burn that is already there.

good_modifiers.word: Furnace Fist: a hotter blow that leaves you hotter
Bursting Fist: a wider burst and more damage, for more essence
Flashing Fist: the target is Dazed as well
Banked Fist: hold it for a harder blow

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite in spirit, and it already interrupts: nothing to add, falls back to a little power
it already sets Alight and nothing on it lasts; falls back to a little power
nothing lasts; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Cinder Spit
skills.summary: A quick, cheap bolt that sets its target Alight. Weak cold; it is how you get hot.
skills.verb_fit: Ignite is "start a fire at a point": a coal that starts one where it lands, as fast as you can spit.

good_modifiers.word: Blazing Spit: hits harder and builds heat faster
Piercing Spit: passes through, lighting each body in the line
Rapid Spit: even less recovery
Cheap Spit: less essence for the same heat - pure heat-building

bad_modifiers.why: it already sets Alight; falls back to a little power
a coal in flight has nothing that lasts; falls back
its own opposite: a spit that puts the fire out as it lights it. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Flashover
skills.summary: A short dash that leaves a line of flame for 3 s: anything standing in it catches. It does not carry you through enemies.
skills.verb_fit: Ignite along a line: the dash starts a fire everywhere you were.

good_modifiers.word: Smouldering Trail: the line burns half as long again
Lasting Trail: the line stays longer
Quick Flashover: a faster dash
Wide Trail: a broader line of flame

bad_modifiers.why: maths lets it through, but on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, not a modifier; and it is the opposite of a fire you leave behind
a trail that drags everyone standing in it toward its middle line every tick. Maths lets it act; it should not
a dash cannot be held, and it has no damage or wind-up: falls back to a cost cut

skills.name: Pyre Call
skills.summary: Every Alight enemy within 10 m loses its stacks, and each stack bursts for 35 in 2 m. Spread the burns first; call them once.
skills.verb_fit: Explode is "blast outward": every burn you set blows out at once.

good_modifiers.word: Roaring Pyre: bigger bursts
Wide Pyre: bursts reach farther
Distant Pyre: calls fires from farther off

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, and it has no hit payload to pull with: falls back to a little power
nothing it hits to interrupt (no hit payload); falls back to a little power
one blast; nothing lasts. Falls back to a little power

skills.name: Backdraft
skills.summary: Open the door. First every enemy within 5 m is drawn 2 m toward you, then the blast: they take 4 x the heat you carry above 20, and your fire reflux drops to 20. 320 at full heat; nothing when cold.
skills.verb_fit: Implode is "flame rushing inward": the air rushes in, then the fire follows it out.

new_mechanics.name: pull_before_blast
new_mechanics.definition: A melee_burst with a top-level pull drags every enemy within its reach that far toward the caster when the wind-up starts, before the hit.

good_modifiers.word: Wide Backdraft: a 6.5 m room-clearer
Tight Backdraft: smaller and harder
Sudden Backdraft: shorter wind-up
Quenching Backdraft: cashes in the same heat for more

bad_modifiers.why: Backdraft spends all the fire at once; nothing it leaves lasts. Duration falls back; Alight only partly lands
nothing lasts; falls back to a little power
it leaves no reflux to calm; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Bellows Breath
skills.summary: Hold: a cone of fire 5 m long and 60 degrees wide. 50 damage a second and 1 Alight every half second to everything in it. You walk at 45% while holding. 6 essence a second, and every second of it heats you - the fastest way to get hot.
skills.verb_fit: Blaze is "a fierce, spreading fire": a fire you keep feeding, spreading across everything in front of you.

good_modifiers.word: Long Breath: a 7 m cone
Wide Breath: a broader cone
Dazzling Breath: Dazes what it burns
Roaring Breath: bigger and harder, for more essence

bad_modifiers.why: maths lets it through, but on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, not a modifier, and smoke smothers the fire it is breathing
it already sets Alight every tick and has no wind-up; falls back to a little power
maths lets it through, but on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, not a modifier

skills.name: Stoke
skills.summary: At once, +25 heat. For 6 s every bare strike you land sets its target Alight. Light a man with your hands, then Kiln Fist him.
skills.verb_fit: Blaze is "a fierce, spreading fire": you throw fuel on your own fire at once, and it spreads to everything your hands touch.

new_mechanics.name: Stoke on Blaze
new_mechanics.definition: Rune moved from Smoulder (FIR-4b) to Blaze (FIR-4a), approved; numbers unchanged. strike_status names what its bare strikes apply (it was implied by the buff id).

good_modifiers.word: Long Stoke: your strikes light things for longer
it acts on you: longer
Banked Stoke: lasts half as long again

bad_modifiers.why: the opposite of feeding the fire, and it has no reflux or damage to change: falls back to a cost cut
nothing it hits; falls back to a cost cut
a fire inside you has no reach; falls back to a cost cut

skills.name: Slag Pool
skills.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: 3 m across for 6 s. 25 a second and 1 Alight a second to enemies standing in it.
skills.verb_fit: Smoulder is "a low, lasting burn": molten floor that keeps burning whatever stands on it.

good_modifiers.word: Long Slag: lasts half as long again
Dense Slag: smaller and hotter
Blazing Slag: hits harder and heats you more
Wide Slag: a bigger pool

bad_modifiers.why: maths lets it through, but on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, not a modifier, on a fire you meant to keep burning
a pool does not travel; no speed, falls back to a little power
no wind-up to shorten; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Hiss
skills.summary: One burning enemy within 9 m: every Alight stack on it goes out at once and it takes 48 per stack, all now - what the burn would still have done, and a little more. Your fire reflux drops 6 per stack. Five stacks: 240 damage and 30 heat off. Leaves no reflux of its own.
skills.verb_fit: Quench is "put fire out, and cash the heat in": it puts one body's fire out, cashes it as damage, and cools you.

new_mechanics.name: new:seize
new_mechanics.definition: An instant effect on the one enemy under the cursor (or your locked target) within range; walls and stone block it; it is checked before essence is spent. With a delay, the target is marked and the hit lands that many seconds later wherever it has moved.

new_mechanics.name: vent_per_stack
new_mechanics.definition: Lowers the caster's fire reflux by this much for each stack consumed (after the hit, so its Heat bonus is measured hot).

good_modifiers.word: Cold Iron: more from each stack
Long Hiss: reaches farther
Choking Hiss: the fire goes out and so does its swing - interrupts

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: relights what it just put out. Maths lets it act; it should not
one moment; nothing lasts. Falls back to a little power
nothing travels; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Wickpinch
skills.summary: Costs no essence: it burns 15 of your heat instead, and cannot be cast below 15. One enemy within 7 m has its flame pinched out: whatever it was doing is interrupted - even an attack that is not marked as interruptible - and it loses 40 poise. A Censer-Bearer snuffed this way no longer bursts when it dies.
skills.verb_fit: Snuff is "put out one flame or source at once": one body, one flame, out.

new_mechanics.name: new:seize
new_mechanics.definition: An instant effect on the one enemy under the cursor (or your locked target) within range; walls and stone block it; it is checked before essence is spent. With a delay, the target is marked and the hit lands that many seconds later wherever it has moved.

new_mechanics.name: heat_cost
new_mechanics.definition: The skill is paid in the caster's fire reflux instead of essence; it cannot be cast with less heat than this.

new_mechanics.name: hard_interrupt
new_mechanics.definition: An interrupt that cancels any enemy wind-up, not only those marked interruptible (elites included).

new_mechanics.name: quells_censer
new_mechanics.definition: A Censer-Bearer hit by it loses its death burst for good.

good_modifiers.word: Flash and Pinch: Dazed as well
Choke the Wick: Slowed after
Long Pinch: reach the drummer at the back
Heavy Pinch: more poise

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: lights the thing it puts out. Maths lets it act (status and recovery); it should not
it costs no essence to cut; falls back to a little power
it deals no damage and leaves no reflux; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Flashpan
skills.summary: A flash of flame from your hands across a 90-degree cone 6 m deep. 30 damage, and everyone in it that is facing you is Blinded: it cannot aim and its blows miss you, for 1 s plus 1 s for every 30 heat you carry (up to 4 s). Archers lose their aim. Enemies with their backs to you are not blinded.
skills.verb_fit: Flare is "a sudden flash of flame": the flash is the weapon; the hotter you are, the brighter it is.

new_mechanics.name: blinded
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, time set by the skill. Cannot aim: its attacks on the caster miss and a ranged enemy loses its aim and must start again.

new_mechanics.name: status_s_per_heat
new_mechanics.definition: The applied status lasts status_s plus this many seconds per point of fire reflux, up to status_s_max.

new_mechanics.name: needs_facing
new_mechanics.definition: Only enemies whose front faces the caster take the status.

good_modifiers.word: Burning Flash: sets them Alight too
Wide Flash: a broader cone
Bright Flash: more damage, more heat
Long Flash: a deeper cone

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: smoke over the flash. Maths lets it act (interrupt and slow); it should not
a flash has nothing that lasts on the skill itself; falls back to a little power
a flash is instant; there is no wind-up to hold. Only the damage half lands

skills.name: Smokepall
skills.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: a pall of smoke 3 m across. Enemies in it are Slowed, ranged enemies cannot see into or through it, and Alight burns on enemies inside do not run down. Lasts 4 s, plus 1 s for every 20 heat you carry (up to 9 s).
skills.verb_fit: Smother is "starve a fire, or a foe, of air": the foes choke and slow; the fires inside are banked, not fed.

new_mechanics.name: blocks_sight
new_mechanics.definition: A zone that ranged enemies cannot see into or through: they cannot target anyone inside or beyond it.

new_mechanics.name: banks
new_mechanics.definition: A status on enemies inside the zone does not run down while they stay in it.

new_mechanics.name: life_per_heat
new_mechanics.definition: The zone lasts its life plus this many seconds per point of fire reflux at the cast, up to life_max.

good_modifiers.word: Thick Pall: lasts longer
Wide Pall: covers more
Smouldering Pall: lasts longer, and lights those inside
Ember Pall: everyone inside catches - and their burns are banked

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a flash inside the smoke. Maths lets it act (Dazed); it should not
a pall does not travel; no speed, falls back to a cost cut
no wind-up to shorten; falls back to a cost cut
